archived_mock_cases.disposition: File-local mocks supply every claimed transition. Preserved only as a historical coordinator contract.
File-local mocks manufacture wallet, block, inclusion, and reward results.
The handwritten registration handler treats signature length as verification and imports no production verifier.
Both byte-identical copies assert values returned by local Jest mocks; neither is production staking evidence.
Both byte-identical copies obtain balances, transactions, and signatures from local mocks.
Both byte-identical copies assert pool and fee values authored by local mocks; no production pool exists in core4.

production_evidence.proves: Real commit/reveal, signed attestations, block production, state application, zero reward without quorum, and positive contributor post-state with quorum.
production_evidence.limit: The fixture seeds a synthetic 2-of-2 oracle configuration, trust, and reputation. It proves the core sink, not deployed attestation discovery or the final N=3/K=2 genesis configuration.

production_evidence.command: cargo test --locked -p wrfcoin-native-chain --bin launch_api --features p2p genesis_oracle_set_s4 && cargo test --locked -p wrfcoin-native-chain --test genesis_oracle_registration_s4
production_evidence.proves: The final N=3/K=2 declaration and all three matching block-1 registrations converge through producer, peer, restart, and sync, with tampered/incomplete registration rejection.
production_evidence.limit: Seeded vector keys stand in for the three ceremony identities and their distinct signing keys. This does not prove hardware custody, deployment of independent attesters, or the public cut; no add-later path is claimed.

production_evidence.command: cargo test --locked -p wrfcoin-shared-protocol --features hsm,test-support --test tdd_reward_determinism && cargo test --locked -p wrfcoin-shared-protocol --features hsm,test-support --test economic_property_tests supply_cap_holds_during_block_production_across_block_time_tiers
production_evidence.proves: Reward units, arithmetic boundaries, non-vacuous phase coverage, and supply-cap behavior through production block application.
production_evidence.limit: The exact expected curve is branch-sensitive while A2 is in flight; evidence must be rerun at the exact merged curve head.

production_evidence.command: cargo test --locked -p wrfcoin-shared-protocol --features hsm,test-support --test signature_malleability --test block_producer_signing
production_evidence.proves: Real keypairs reach project verification wrappers; corrupt-only and wrong-key controls reject.
production_evidence.limit: This does not prove physical HSM custody or ceremony execution; those have separate hardware/operator gates.
